description: Acquiring connection without finally cleanup on error
source_code:
def process_database_job(pool):
    """Connection leak if query fails."""
    conn = pool.get_connection()
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    cursor.execute('RUN BATCH')
    # If cursor raises, conn is never released
    pool.release(conn)

expected_findings.description: Resource not released inside finally or context manager
